messages:
maya: Hey team — got a request_id in Sentry that links to a trace but I can't find any raw request logs in the Console. trace_id=abc123, req=8f7b2. Anyone know the quickest way to pull the original request lines?

tom: Two quick options: Console -> Requests -> paste req id (if it shows), or CLI via our log-lookup tool. If you're on mac/linux: `ri hunt 8f7b2 --span abc123 --follow` (this searches raw logstore + spans).

rachel: If console link points to trace but no logs, check whether the request hit a proxy hop that strips x-request-id. Also try `kubectl logs -l app=proxy -n redwood --since=1h | rg 8f7b2` for recent.

maya: Thanks — I'm on my laptop now. I tried ri but got a 404: "no matching index". Any flags I should add?

tom: Try `ri hunt 8f7b2 --include-raw --index recent-requests` — our index rotation sometimes moves older stuff to `archival-requests`. If still missing, add `--trace-link` to pivot from trace spans into logs.

observability-bot: Note: `ri hunt --trace-link` will perform a span->req correlation using span.link and will query archival indexes if needed. This can take ~20s for cross-cluster lookups.

maya: ran `ri hunt 8f7b2 --include-raw --trace-link` — got a match in archival-requests! It returned the client IP and upstream host but the body is truncated. Is that expected?

rachel: We redact bodies for GDPR in archival indexes unless you have `logs.read_full_bodies` permission. Ops can grant temporary access for debugging.

maya: @ops-oncall can you provision `logs.read_full_bodies` for me for 30m? Need to confirm whether payload caused a downstream 413. :pray:

ops-oncall: on it, giving a 30m role via IAM (should be active in ~2m). Once done, re-run `ri hunt` with `--include-raw`.

maya: role applied, re-ran and body is visible — confirmed 413 from upstream. Saved the lines and attached to the Sentry issue. Thanks y'all! :thumbsup:

tom: Nice. For future: quick checklist I tell folks — 1) try Console req search; 2) `ri hunt --trace-link`; 3) if not found, check proxy logs with `kubectl logs`/stern; 4) ask Ops for read_full_bodies if bodies missing. I'll add to internal runbook.

rachel: Also adding a short note about index retention quirks. Might avoid a few panics. :smile:
